analyst.summary: Sobha is a premium residential developer whose sales bookings have re-accelerated sharply (a record Rs 3,656 crore in the latest quarter, up 48% year-on-year), with debt down nearly 60% since 2019. Reported profitability still looks modest because Indian real-estate accounting recognizes revenue only as projects are completed, so today's earnings reflect an older, smaller project base rather than the much larger pipeline now being built and sold. We see this as a Hold: the current momentum is real and should show up in earnings over the next few years, though real estate remains a cyclical, rate-sensitive business worth monitoring closely rather than a risk-free compounder.
